title: Head and Shoulders
mission: The telemetry stream 'sensor_stream.log' contains 1,000 lines of data. The mission flag is recorded precisely at line 500. Use 'head' and 'tail' to extract line 500!
hint: Pipe 'head' into 'tail': 'head -n 500 sensor_stream.log | tail -n 1' to isolate the exact line.
